name: adversarial-canary
author: OmniCortex
description: A shadow test behind the chat: asks the model again with small perturbations to see if its answer holds, plants a canary instruction in pasted material to see if the model obeys text it should only read, and screens the prompt for injection attempts.

checks.name: canary
checks.title: Canary
checks.help: re-asks with perturbations (answer stability) and plants a canary in pasted text (prompt-injection susceptibility); costs a few short extra model calls

checks.name: injection
checks.title: Injection signs
checks.help: signs in your message or pasted text that it tries to give the model instructions; no model call

nodes.title: Canary: stability and injection probe

params.name: model
params.help: model to probe (default: the one loaded)

nodes.help: Runs the canary probes on a prompt before the main model answers it; fails when the answer is unstable or the planted canary is obeyed.
